phrase.zh: 故事从脚下的土地开始。
phrase.en: Stories begin with the land beneath our feet.

visual.zh: 大幅钢笔尖从左上角进入，在前景土壤处落笔；田垄向右侧远处延伸，右下角有麦穗，远景仅保留树木与低丘。黑白版保留金属刻线、土块和田垄的材质差异。
visual.en: A large steel pen nib enters from upper left and meets foreground soil. Furrows sweep right into trees and low hills; wheat sits at lower right. Neutral monochrome distinguishes the metal nib, earth and field rows.

background.zh:
赛珍珠获得1938年诺贝尔文学奖，获奖理由包括她对中国农民生活丰富而真实的史诗般描写，以及传记作品。她在诺贝尔演讲中谈到中国小说传统。画面让钢笔尖接触翻耕的土壤，麦穗与田垄把写作和土地上的生活联系起来。这是原创寓意，不是小说中的具体场景，也不声称重现某地农田；配图不能代表她全部作品或获奖理由。短句为原创。
1938年文学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：对中国农民生活作出丰富而真实的史诗般描写，并创作杰出的传记作品
background.en:
Pearl Buck received the 1938 Nobel Prize in Literature for rich, epic portrayals of Chinese peasant life and her biographical masterpieces. Her Nobel lecture discussed the Chinese novel tradition. A pen nib touches tilled soil while wheat and furrows connect writing with life on the land. This is an original metaphor, not a scene from a novel or a reconstruction of a particular farm. The image does not represent all her works or the entire award motivation. The phrase is original.
1938 — The Nobel Prize in Literature. Received the full prize. Official motivation: for her rich and truly epic descriptions of peasant life in China and for her biographical masterpieces
